About the business

Hi, we’re KGMTLAKS.

KGMTLAKS PTY-LTD is the photography business of Kgotso George Matlakala (KGM), based in Gauteng, South Africa. Every shoot starts with listening – to the couple, the host or the tournament organiser – so the final gallery feels like their day.

We love the big moments, but we are just as drawn to the small ones: a ring balanced on a heel, a glove on a driver, the first laugh of the morning.

  • Natural, story-led coverage
  • Edited in colour and black & white
  • Every image delivered with the KGM TLAKS signature

Behind the business

The story behind KGMTLAKS.

KGMTLAKS is the photography business of Kgotso George Matlakala – KGM – built around one idea: your event should be remembered the way it felt, not just the way it looked.

The man behind the lens

Kgotso George Matlakala – KGM.

KGMTLAKS PTY-LTD is the photography business of Kgotso George Matlakala. The KGM in the name are his initials, and the business trades as TLAKS Photography from Gauteng, South Africa.

The work covers weddings, golf days and corporate events, and birthdays and private celebrations – the wide, joyful group shot and the quiet close-up of a ring, a glove or a cake topper. The small details are what bring a memory back years later, so they never get skipped.

Every photograph is delivered with the KGM TLAKS signature – a mark that has become part of how clients recognise and share their gallery.

The brand

A logo built like a viewfinder

The mark is drawn like a camera: the brackets frame the moment, the lens sits at the corner, and KGM – Kgotso George Matlakala’s initials – sits at the centre of the frame, with TLAKS Photography beneath. It’s the same signature you’ll find in the corner of every photo in the portfolio.

01

Story first

We start by listening, so the gallery reflects your day, not a template.

02

Respect the moment

Unobtrusive, candid coverage so hosts and guests can simply enjoy themselves.

03

Details matter

Rings, décor, tables, tees – the small things get their own frame.

04

How we work

From first message to final gallery

  1. 1

    Listen

    You tell us about the occasion, the people and what matters most.

  2. 2

    Plan

    We agree the date, venue, timings and the moments to be sure we capture.

  3. 3

    Shoot

    Relaxed, attentive coverage – from the big moments to the small details.

  4. 4

    Edit

    Each photograph is carefully colour-graded, with black & white where it fits the story.

  5. 5

    Deliver

    Your finished gallery arrives with the KGM TLAKS signature, ready to share.
